title: MyLinden prescription terms: lost and stolen medication entitlements by class
content:
Under the Linden Ridge Prescriptions & Renewals terms, whether a replacement fill can be authorized for medication that was lost or stolen depends on the class of the prescription, as does the number of replacement fills one prescription may receive in a rolling 12 months and whether a police report number is needed when the medication was stolen.

| Class | Replacement fill for lost or stolen medication | Replacement fills per prescription in a rolling 12 months | Police report number required for stolen medication |
|---|---|---|---|
| Acute Short-Course Prescription | not available | 0 | no |
| Standard Maintenance Prescription | available | 1 | no |
| Monitored Maintenance Prescription | available | 1 | no |
| Schedule III-V Controlled Prescription | not available | 0 | no |
| Schedule II Controlled Prescription | not available | 0 | no |
| Specialty Medication Prescription | available | 1 | yes |

**Terms.**

(i) Where the class makes a replacement available, the cap is 1 replacement fill per prescription in a rolling 12 months.

(ii) The Specialty Medication Prescription is the only class whose stolen-medication replacement requires a police report number.

(iii) The Acute Short-Course Prescription and both controlled classes carry no replacement entitlement and show a cap of 0.
